user.title: Add a Dooya remote
user.description: Select a 433.934 MHz RF transmitter and enter the ID of a remote already paired with your blinds. One cover will be created for each channel, starting at channel 1.

data_description.remote_id: Decimal or hexadecimal with a 0x prefix (for example, 0x00123C14).

error.invalid_remote_id: Enter a remote ID between 0 and 16777215, in decimal or hexadecimal with a 0x prefix.
error.invalid_channels: Enter a whole number of channels between 1 and 255.
error.invalid_transmitter: Select a compatible 433.934 MHz OOK transmitter.

abort.no_transmitters: Add an RF transmitter to Home Assistant before setting up Dooya RF.
abort.no_compatible_transmitters: No RF transmitter supports 433.934 MHz with OOK modulation.

init.title: Dooya carrier frequency
init.description: Requested RF frequency for this remote. OpenHARF applies the radio’s existing crystal calibration.

error.invalid_frequency: Enter a whole-number frequency in Hz between 1 and 4294967295.
error.unsupported_frequency: The selected transmitter does not support this frequency with OOK modulation, or is no longer available.
